name: hoverdeck
displayName: HoverDeck🏆 for Claude, Codex and any AI agent
description: One deck for all your AI agents: Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, OpenCode, Pi and OpenRouter in a chat with a browser, Git and terminals — in VS Code, in Chrome and from your phone.

hoverdeck.chat.connectionPermissions.title: Connection Permissions
hoverdeck.chat.connectionPermissions.description: Optional restrictions for Chrome and Exchange. Manage these in HoverDeck Chat Settings → Connections & permissions. Supported actions are enabled unless explicitly disabled.

hoverdeck.chat.sound.githubRun.title: Sound When a Watched Actions Run Ends

hoverdeck.chat.notifications.githubRun.title: Notify When a Watched Actions Run Ends

hoverdeck.chat.remoteFilesChrome.markdownDescription: Project file access from Chrome. Controls Files and project attachments inside the conversation's working folder. Agent tool approvals and sandbox permissions are separate. Change this in VS Code only.

hoverdeck.chat.remoteFilesWebsite.markdownDescription: Project file access from the connected website. Controls Files and project attachments inside the conversation's working folder. Agent tool approvals and sandbox permissions are separate. Change this in VS Code only.

hoverdeck.chat.chromeTerminalAccess.title: Chrome Terminal Access
hoverdeck.chat.chromeTerminalAccess.description: Allow the paired Chrome extension on this computer to use this terminal capability. Exchange has separate permissions.

hoverdeck.chat.chromeTerminalShell.title: Open Shell Terminals from Chrome
hoverdeck.chat.chromeTerminalShell.description: Allow the paired Chrome extension on this computer to use this terminal capability. Exchange has separate permissions.

hoverdeck.chat.chromeTerminalAgent.title: Open Agent Terminals from Chrome
hoverdeck.chat.chromeTerminalAgent.description: Allow the paired Chrome extension on this computer to use this terminal capability. Exchange has separate permissions.

hoverdeck.chat.remoteTerminalShell.title: Open Plain Terminals from Chrome and the Website

hoverdeck.chat.remoteWorkflowShell.title: Run Workflows with Shell Steps from Chrome and the Website

hoverdeck.chat.remoteTerminalAgent.title: Open Agent Terminals from Chrome and the Website

hoverdeck.chat.exchangeKeepAwakeMinutes.title: Keep Awake After Exchange Connection
hoverdeck.chat.exchangeKeepAwakeMinutes.markdownDescription: Prevent automatic system sleep when a website viewer connects to this chat through Exchange. Each new viewer renews the timer. 0 disables this trigger; -1 keeps the computer awake until you turn it off or close the VS Code window. The display may still sleep.

hoverdeck.chat.voiceLanguage.title: Voice Message Language
hoverdeck.chat.voiceLanguage.patternErrorMessage: A language tag such as ru-RU or en-US, or empty for the Mac's own language.

scripts.compile: npm run build-ext && npm run build-webview
scripts.build-ext: npm run clean-ext && tsc --project ./tsconfig.json && node scripts/stage-terminal.mjs
scripts.test:chat-ui: npm run build-webview && npm run build-chrome && node exchange-server/scripts/build-chat.mjs && node scripts/test-visualizations-browser.mjs
scripts.publish:ovsx: npm run package && ovsx publish hoverdeck.vsix
